domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India sales split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com, trademo.com and eximpedia.app all returned HTTP 403; web_search backend was unavailable (searx connection refused) for all queries. Nothing to quote.
note: Legal entity appears to exist and be active in Indian customs data (267 records, latest 2026-02-27), so no rejection ground. The declared HS codes 382440 (mortars/concretes), 390910 (urea/formaldehyde resins) and 392190 (plastic sheets) are NOT the codes seen in the visible records — visible codes are 68079090 (bitumen/asphalt articles), 39189090, 56031300, 39201019, all on the import side. Per rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the actually observed codes. Export side: only the platform's aggregate counter (267) supports any export activity; no dated outbound B/L with destination and HS was readable, so export_status is 'declared_only', not 'confirmed'. Domestic supply: no evidence found either way — 'unknown', not 'none_found', because the registries that would carry GST/turnover data were blocked (403) rather than empty. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in the sources reachable; not estimated. Note the company is the Indian arm of Spain's DANOSA Group (imports from DANOSA GROUP S.A., Valencia and Derivados Asfalticos Normalizados), i.e. likely manufacturer_trader role, but role classification is outside this task.
